name: Deadly Proficiency
body:
School divination; Level antipaladin 1, bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1, lathspell 1, paladin 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components S, F (a weapon or shield)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 hour/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

With a touch, the knowledge of soldiers and generals flows through your target.

When you cast this spell you draw the focus with a flourish and lay a hand on your target. The target of the spell gains proficiency with the type of weapon or shield used as the focus for this spell. If the target is already proficient, they deal damage with the weapon as though it were one size larger.
